name: WiderStopForSmallSignalBarCapped
longCondition: el_gt(ctx.MarketPosition(), 0) && (el_le(close[0], sigLow - stopOffsetUsed) || el_le(close[0], ctx.EntryPrice() - maxStopDistance))
shortCondition: el_lt(ctx.MarketPosition(), 0) && (el_ge(close[0], sigHigh + stopOffsetUsed) || el_ge(close[0], ctx.EntryPrice() + maxStopDistance))
